units.text: ⟦0⟧ specifies the desired line-wrap length; a length of 0 (zero) means to never wrap long lines. If omitted, the default as specified on the command line is used. The ⟦1⟧ parameter is a GNU ⟦2⟧ extension.

units.text: If pattern space contains no newline, start a normal new cycle as if the ⟦0⟧ command was issued. Otherwise, delete text in the pattern space up to the first newline, and restart cycle with the resultant pattern space, without reading a new line of input.

units.sourceHTML: When -z is used, a zero byte (the ascii ‘NUL’ character) is added between the lines (instead of a new line).
